text:
Toast

Ingredients:
2 slices bread

Optional toppings (use any):
Butter
Jam or jelly
Cream cheese
Avocado, sliced or mashed
Peanut butter
Honey

Instructions:
1. Toast the bread in the toaster until golden, about 2-3 minutes.
2. Add your toppings and serve.
note: Everyday staple, 1 serving — Yidi specifically asked how toast gets recorded: as a tiny recipe like this, so it can be planned and shopped. The toppings are optional ingredients. Kosher: pareve (the bread itself). Category: Side. Tags: breakfast, lunch, quick, staple.
